summary.interpretation: d' is the class-mean separation in pooled standard deviations, for Mikania against the WORST-CASE native climber. d' < 1 means the distributions overlap so heavily that no threshold separates them; d' > 2 is comfortably separable. The multispectral ceiling is the best of the RGB and 5-band tiers, since a multispectral sensor also carries the visible bands.
summary.caveat: These are single-feature separabilities on library-drawn spectra at leaf/patch scale. They bound what any THRESHOLD on one index can do; a multivariate classifier on many weak features can exceed the best single d'. Stage 05 measures that properly, on spatially disjoint sites.

_summary.validation: leave-one-site-out over 6 virtual sites with (site, species) random effects
_summary.finding: During the autumn bloom every sensor tier performs well — which REPRODUCES the published result that RGB deep learning succeeds on blooming outbreak points, and is therefore a validation of the simulator rather than a weakness of it. The commercial argument is entirely in the foliage-only case, where the bloom is absent and the broadband tiers lose their cue. That is proposal §6.1(2): 'RGB can do it for two months a year.'
_summary.note: Library-level (leaf/patch scale). Optimistic bound, not a field result: no atmosphere, no BRDF, no mixed pixels, no georeferencing error. Stage 05 repeats this on simulated scenes; only site-disjoint scene numbers may be quoted externally.

leakage_demo.warning: NOT REPORTABLE. Spatially autocorrelated pixels appear in both train and test. Included only to quantify the inflation this produces relative to leave-one-site-out (proposal §5.1 mitigation 6).

validation.caveat: All figures are from SIMULATED scenes at species contrast 1.0. They validate the pipeline and the validation methodology, not Hong Kong field separability, which is unmeasured (proposal Appendix B.5) and is what Phase 0 buys.

control_contrast_zero.meaning: At contrast 0 the climber species are spectrally identical, so any accuracy above chance would indicate the classifier is exploiting something other than species spectra — spatial position, illumination or a simulator artefact — and would invalidate every other figure in this study.

contrast_sweep.interpretation: Contrast 1.0 is the nominal configuration, in which every species deviation in config.species_spectra is applied at full strength. The scale is relative, not physical: it is meaningful for comparing how much separability is NEEDED against how much Phase 0 MEASURES, once the same operators are fitted to real field spectra.
contrast_sweep.caveat: Simulated scenes throughout. The curve characterises the pipeline's sensitivity to separability; it does not predict Hong Kong field accuracy, which remains unmeasured (proposal Appendix B.5).

cut_and_tarp.note: Observed rate is measured from the two simulated epochs; the configured rate is the simulator's input. They differ because detection is imperfect — which is the point: this is what the measurement loop would actually recover from real re-flights.

manual_pull.note: Observed rate is measured from the two simulated epochs; the configured rate is the simulator's input. They differ because detection is imperfect — which is the point: this is what the measurement loop would actually recover from real re-flights.

efficacy.confound_note: Treatment assignment is severity-driven, not randomised, so raw per-method rates are confounded with baseline severity. Reported because that is how a real programme allocates, and flagged because an unflagged comparison would be misleading.
efficacy.caveat: Simulated epochs. What is demonstrated is the measurement loop and its detection floor, not any real treatment's efficacy.

benchmark.class_coverage_note: Botswana classes are spatially segregated, so some blocks contain classes no training fold saw. The 'trainable' figure excludes those pixels; it is the fair comparison against a random split, which by construction never has unseen classes.
benchmark.what_this_proves: The preprocessing chain, feature stack, model factory and spatially-blocked validation machinery all function on real hyperspectral imagery with real sensor noise and real spatial autocorrelation, and the leakage effect reproduces on data this project did not generate.
benchmark.what_this_does_not_prove: Nothing about Mikania micrantha, Hong Kong, or separability from Bauhinia glauca / Byttneria aspera. Different continent, different species, 30 m pixels versus 8 cm. Machinery check only.

meta.title: Mikania micrantha comparative-genomic priors on VNIR reflectance

findings.claim: Sixteen positively-selected genes concentrated in photoreaction and the utilisation of photoassimilates
findings.source: Liu B. et al. (2020) Nature Communications 11:340
findings.note: Selection scan on the chromosome-scale assembly. Positive selection acting on photoreaction genes implies the light reactions themselves, not just growth rate, are the target of adaptation — which is what makes a *pigment* and *photosystem* difference plausible rather than a generic vigour difference.

findings.claim: Enhanced photosynthetic capacity via night-time CO2 absorption supplementing daytime carbon fixation
findings.source: Liu B. et al. (2020) Nature Communications 11:340
findings.note: A CAM-like supplementary carbon route in an otherwise C3 vine. Relevant here mainly because it implies elevated whole-plant carbon gain and therefore supports the high-SLA / fast-turnover leaf economics inference (T3), and because it predicts a DIURNAL component to any spectral difference — which is an acquisition-window constraint, not just a band choice.

findings.claim: Elevated stem photosynthesis efficiency — photosynthetically active tissue outside the leaf lamina
findings.source: Liu B. et al. (2020) Nature Communications 11:340
findings.note: The single most operationally useful finding in the whole literature for this product. A green stem is a chlorophyll-bearing surface with a very different internal structure from a leaf: little spongy mesophyll, so it scatters far less in the NIR while still absorbing in the red. A canopy blanket that mixes leaf and photosynthetic stem therefore has a *shallower NIR plateau relative to its red absorption depth* than a pure-leaf canopy of the same greenness. That is a shape difference, not an amplitude difference, and shape survives illumination variation (proposal §3.2, NIR row).

findings.claim: ~half the genome is LTR retrotransposon, 80% from an expansion within the last ~1 Myr, plus a whole-genome duplication and recent segmental duplications
findings.source: Liu B. et al. (2020) Nature Communications 11:340; Wang et al. (2025) New Phytologist
findings.note: Genome architecture, not phenotype. Included because it is the mechanism by which gene-family dosage changes (F5) arose, and because it is the part of the story that is unambiguously established — useful for credibility even though it makes no direct spectral prediction. Deliberately given no spectral prediction below; a desk study that turns every genomic fact into a band prediction is not a desk study, it is astrology.

findings.claim: Gene family expansion and transposable-element dynamics associated with invasiveness; population structure resolved
findings.source: Wang et al. (2025) New Phytologist — chromosome-scale M. micrantha (~1.53 Gb) and native congener M. cordata (~1.68 Gb)
findings.note: Supplies the direct comparative contrast against a *native congener*, which is the closest published analogue of the discrimination problem AFCD has. Population structure is the hook for the §3.4 roadmap item (regrowth vs recolonisation at treated sites).

findings.claim: Evolution and diurnal expression patterns of photosynthetic pathway genes diverge from congeners
findings.source: The Crop Journal (2023) — diurnal expression of photosynthetic pathway genes in M. micrantha
findings.note: Diurnal divergence is the reason this project constrains its acquisition window rather than flying whenever the weather allows. If the transcriptional difference has a time-of-day structure, the phenotype plausibly does too, and an inconsistent solar window would add a nuisance factor that looks exactly like species variance.

findings.claim: Comparative transcriptomics against native congeners shows divergence in photosynthesis and secondary-metabolite pathways
findings.source: Comparative transcriptome analysis of M. micrantha with native congeners
findings.note: Independent replication of the light-and-carbon convergence in F1/F2/F3 by a different method on different material. Two methods agreeing is the reason §4.2 can call the science "published, replicated in adjacent species, and consistent" rather than a single-paper result.

findings.claim: Defensive secondary-metabolite mechanisms likely enhance invasiveness
findings.source: Defensive Mechanisms of Mikania micrantha ... (2025)
findings.note: The basis for the anthocyanin / flavonoid row of the §3.2 table. Weakest link in the set: "secondary metabolite pathway divergence" is a long way from "a measurable 550-580 nm shoulder", and the desk study scores it accordingly rather than flattering it.

traits.trait: Altered standing chlorophyll pool and chlorophyll a/b ratio
traits.rationale: Selection on photoreaction genes and divergent expression of photosynthetic pathway genes act on the light-harvesting apparatus. Light-harvesting complex composition sets the chlorophyll a/b ratio and the total pigment pool per unit leaf area. This is the least contentious of the trait inferences, but it is still an inference: transcript abundance is not pigment concentration.

traits.trait: Chlorophyll-bearing, low-mesophyll stem tissue contributing to the canopy signal
traits.rationale: Directly implied by the published finding rather than inferred at a distance — elevated stem photosynthesis requires chlorophyll in the stem. The inference is only about the *proportion of a canopy patch* that this tissue occupies at 8 cm GSD, which is a canopy-architecture question the ground library must measure.

traits.trait: High specific leaf area, thin lamina, rapid leaf turnover
traits.rationale: The classic fast-growth end of the leaf economics spectrum, consistent with a vine that blankets a canopy in a season. Thin lamina means fewer internal air-cell interfaces and therefore a lower NIR plateau — but this is an AMPLITUDE effect, and §3.2 warns that amplitude differences are confounded by illumination. Ranked accordingly.

traits.trait: Divergent flavonoid / anthocyanin standing pools
traits.rationale: Weak chain, honestly labelled. Defensive-chemistry divergence need not touch the specific pigments that absorb in the visible, and anthocyanin is the most environmentally labile pigment of the three (config/default.yaml `nuisance` gives it the largest within-class CV for that reason).

traits.trait: Two-layer blanket: vine layer draped over, not integrated into, host canopy
traits.rationale: Growth-habit trait rather than a molecular one; the genomic findings support only the growth *rate* that makes the habit possible. Included because the resulting mixed-pixel structure is what makes unmixing the right tool (§3.2, final paragraph), and because that is a structural prediction the imagery can test independently of any pigment claim.

ranked_operational.measures: Wavelength of maximum first derivative across the red edge
ranked_operational.falsification: Mikania mean REP does not exceed the native-climber mean REP by at least 1 nm in the ground spectral library, in either season, at p < 0.05 by a site-blocked test.
ranked_operational.why_broadband_misses: Multispectral gives a red-edge BAND, not a POSITION.

acquisition_constraints.constraint: Restrict acquisition to a fixed solar-time window; do not mix morning and afternoon sorties within a comparison
acquisition_constraints.rationale: Night-time CO2 uptake and diurnally-structured expression of photosynthetic genes both imply the physiological state — and therefore plausibly the pigment and water status driving P1, P5 and P8 — varies through the day. A time-of-day difference between two flights would masquerade as a species or site difference. This is a batch effect in the §5.1(7) sense, and the control is design, not correction.
acquisition_constraints.cost_consequence: Narrows usable hours below the ~8 h daylight assumption in §5.2, worsening §5.3 coverage economics

acquisition_constraints.constraint: A constitutive photosystem signal should be measured OUT of the flowering window to be worth anything
acquisition_constraints.rationale: §6.1(2) claims year-round capability on the grounds that a constitutive photosystem signal is more temporally stable than a transient flowering one. That claim is only tested by measuring in the foliage-only season. Measuring in bloom and inferring the rest would be assuming the conclusion.
acquisition_constraints.cost_consequence: Requires at least two acquisition seasons in Phase 0 — already budgeted in §7.3 item 1

genomic_priors.headline: 8 falsifiable spectral predictions derived from 8 published genomic, transcriptomic and physiological findings via 5 inferred trait chains. Every chain terminates in an `inferred_optical` step: no leaf-optical measurement linking these genes to reflectance exists for Hong Kong material. These are the measurements the Phase 0 spectroradiometer campaign should make, ranked by what is worth measuring rather than by what is best cited.

genomic_validation.scope: Species contrasts in the stage-02 library are MODELLED (config §3) on a real measured leaf base, and are swept in stage 05. This stage validates the falsification machinery and shows the form of the Phase 0 deliverable. It establishes nothing about Hong Kong material.

band_selection.weighting_note: Applying the prior as per-band feature WEIGHTS produces exactly zero effect: StandardScaler restores unit variance per band, and tree ensembles are invariant to monotone per-feature rescaling. §3.3(a) is only implementable as band selection.

band_prior_weights.note: Normalised to mean 1.0. No band is ever zero-weighted: the priors are hypotheses, and a hard zero would make them unfalsifiable by preventing the data from contradicting them. Stage 10 measures whether this weighting actually helps.

sweep.interpretation: A programme with uncertified labels evaluates itself against the same faulty labels it trained on, so its go/no-go verdict is about the labels as much as the classifier. `kill_criterion_masked` is the failure Risk 9 predicts (pass the test, fail reality); `kill_criterion_spuriously_failed` is the one actually measured (abandon a classifier that works).

certification_allocation.interpretation: The go/no-go verdict is computed on the hold-out, so it depends on the VALIDATION labels being right and barely at all on the training labels. Certifying the training set alone cannot repair the decision, because the number the decision is read from is never touched.

disagreement_targeting.interpretation: Ranking specimens by model-label disagreement concentrates the genuine label errors into the top of the list, so a partial sequencing budget recovers far more than its share of them. Random sampling recovers exactly its share, by construction.

loci.ncbi_query: (ITS2 OR internal transcribed spacer 2 OR internal transcribed spacer)
loci.note: Highest species-level discrimination and by far the best-represented locus for Mikania in public databases. Caveat carried into adjudication: ITS is nuclear and multi-copy, so intragenomic variants and fungal-endophyte co-amplification are real failure modes, not theoretical ones.

Highly variable intergenic spacer; length variation and mononucleotide repeats make alignment and Sanger base-calling harder than the length suggests. Reference coverage for HK climbers is the sparsest of the four — which is Risk 10 made measurable rather than assumed.

deposition.rationale: A barcode sequence alone does not let a competitor build the product; the sequence-to-spectrum-to-place linkage does. Depositing the former buys scientific credibility (§10.7 academic collaboration, §7.4 ECF application) at no competitive cost.

assumptions: Swath is MODELLED from an assumed ~22 deg FOV at 90 m AGL and is marked [VERIFY] in the proposal. It scales the whole model linearly.
Ground speed is SNR-limited, not line-rate-limited, in VNIR at 8 cm GSD under subtropical canopy illumination.
Operational efficiency folds in turns, battery swaps, RTH and re-flights; it is the least defensible number here and should be replaced with measured Phase 0 sortie logs.

revenue.note: Prices are inferred from general survey-services benchmarks, not from any observed HK government contract (proposal Appendix B.6). Treat as an order-of-magnitude sanity check, not a quotation.

phase0.note: Line items are indicative and unquoted. The point of the check is that the ask is reconstructible from the workplan, not that these are the prices a supplier would give.
